chunks: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, who said:

A prohibition was issued regarding the visitation of the graveyards of Quraish and Al-Hayr. When some months had passed, the minister Al-Baqitani called him and said to him: 'Convey to the people of Bani al-Furat and Al-Barasiyyin and tell them not to visit the graveyards of Quraish, for the Caliph has ordered that he closely monitors anyone who visits and arrests him.' As for what appeared from his side, peace be upon him, of the autographs (tawqi'at), they are numerous, and we mention a portion of them.

key_terms.التَّوْقِيعَاتِ: Autographs (written responses from the Imam to his followers)
key_terms.الْبَاقِطَانِي: Al-Baqitani (a prominent minister during the Minor Occultation)
key_terms.الْحَيْرِ: Al-Hayr (a location associated with the Imams' burial or visitation)
key_terms.بَنِي الْفُرَاتِ: Bani al-Furat (a prominent family/clan during the Occultation)
key_terms.مَقَابِرُ قُرَيْشٍ: The graveyards of Quraish (referring to the Imams buried in Kadhimiyya)

ai.seo_question: What was the prohibition regarding the visitation of the Imams' shrines during the Minor Occultation?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* illustrates the political tensions of the Minor Occultation, where the Abbasid Caliphate enforced a prohibition on visiting the Imams' shrines in Quraish and Al-Hayr to suppress Shi'a devotion. The minister Al-Baqitani’s specific directive to the Banu al-Furat and al-Barsiyyin highlights the strategic management of the community during periods of surveillance, while the mention of abundant *tawqi'at* (autographs) underscores the Imam’s continued guidance despite physical absence.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 244 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Yaqub from Ali Ibn Muhammad that he said:

“A prohibition came forbidding visitations to the graveyard in Kadhimiyya and the Shrines. A few months later, the minister called Baqitani said to him, “Tell the people of Bani Furat and village of Bars not to visit the graveyard at Kadhmain, because the caliph has ordered that anyone who comes there must be watched and arrested.”
